Fixes background loss, unintended deletion across Canvases, and custom-size contracts.

- Show and restore the Prompter Background field, preserving its text when Scene or color slots are edited.
- Apply Delete/Backspace only to the focused Canvas and release event handlers when removing the node.
- Send supported `Custom` and dimensions for User size presets, preserving the UI selection and migrating older saved values.
- Preserve relative BBOX placement for runtime width/height overrides, including non-previewable sources and legacy pixel layouts. Avoid double scaling frontend-remapped coordinates.

Validation: 20 JavaScript, 14 Python and 29 publication-configuration tests passed (63 total). ComfyUI_test UI behavior was confirmed by the user. No new GPU generation test was performed.

Restart ComfyUI after updating, then hard-refresh the browser with Ctrl + F5.

日本語: 背景指定の消失、複数Canvasでの誤削除、Save Customとサイズoverrideの不整合を修正しました。更新後はComfyUIを再起動し、Ctrl + F5でブラウザーを再読み込みしてください。
